verdict.rationale: Replit's docs describe a workflow where the app built by Agent is tested in Preview and then published to a live URL. That confirms a pre-publish preview step. The evidence is a single brief mention, so how interactive and live that preview is goes unproven. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the Preview pane (live reload, interactive testing while Agent edits), explicit confirmation that the preview updates live during building, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.
Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.
